summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Mesoblast Ltd, an Australian foreign private issuer, reporting a press release about achieving the patient recruitment target in its pivotal Phase 3 trial for rexlemestrocel-L in chronic low back pain. The filing discloses a clinical milestone—enrolling at least 300 patients in a placebo-controlled study—and provides details on trial design, endpoints, and expected timeline. It does not involve any transaction or special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine operational update that, while potentially material to the company's prospects, does not constitute a special-situation event under the defined categories. No deal terms are applicable.
